name: thingtime
description: Composable, preview-first Thingtime tools for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Explore and safely compose work across Thingtime.
interface.longDescription: Connect named Thingtime accounts with scoped, revocable tokens. Read exact batches, schemas, relationships and changes; validate data; review signed diffs; apply confirmed mutation plans; inspect history; undo safely; and run bounded reusable Capability workflows without exposing tokens or arbitrary APIs.
defaultPrompt: Use my selected Thingtime account to help with my Things.
Retrieve known Things directly by ID, discover schemas and relationships, and show a signed before/after preview before any composed write.
